notes.title: HOTFIX!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/cba9da36171a4aca87c01d5e8659b6db9a3c2880.png[/img]

Hi again everyone!

We released a hotfix just last night at around 1AM PST on Oct. 19th, 2017.
As I promised, here are the detailed info on what changed in this new version.

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]≪HOTFIX≫[/h1]

The following issues have been addressed and fixed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/5e3976afff83a44974794eb2bc05cd967ab38b90.png[/img]

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]１．Known issues and fixed bugs [/h1]

We’ve noticed similar bugs were being reported upon launch of GOKEN.
This hotfix should resolve these reported issues. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/168142c2afbe860f87d338fdb3810862a3942e55.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f900d89917f829887f2333f601e3203c22955d1e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/650bddae800557e88bbb9be01d08f39eaaae78bc.png[/img]

≪Other Fixed Bugs≫
　・ Adjusted and fixed map data
　・ Fixed a bug where players were unable to use the Inn at Burning Lands
　・ Some Japanese texts appeared bugged
　・ Fixed a bug where some monsters wouldn’t move in certain areas
　・ Fixed a bug where unintended tracks would play
　・ Fixed a bug where the hidden boss would not move under certain conditions
　・Patched an event where players could access certain parts of maps when they aren’t supposed to
　・ Added the correct icon support for Xbox controllers

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]２．Performance Improvements[/h1]

　Fixed stuttering issues and greatly improved loading time. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/ffb622bcfd87b15e6a1eb98c1614ce2085f195fc.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/2fceb10825031365cd7eb43472237776e5f86a69.png[/img]

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]３．Fixed and added dialogues to main story[/h1]

　We’ve improved and added more dialogues to help players enjoy GOKEN more.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/cc94a40f77b2b5e90abea3440e6018f8c0d7a8e1.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31c5fabe364c7ac4cab07922b2a73198d2d69e05.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/48a9937ac3e4e5a236cdb4d15299da123923dd42.png[/img]

≪Other Improvements in Stories≫
　・ Fixed various texts for NPCs
　・ Fixed some texts in cut scenes
　・ Fixed some character motions during events
　・ Fixed some effects played during events

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]４．Improved usability of Daggers[/h1]

We improved the usability of the only ranged weapon in GOKEN, the Daggers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f61fe5bf09bc20ec73fe72ba47f7aac3513b35e1.png[/img]

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]５．Added and reevaluated prizes at Colosseum[/h1]

　Adjusted the rates and added prizes to the Colosseum for players to enjoy

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/e3e73f3b580babe2fb1640642c9521dd01943dbb.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/4a8554c6291b57cfe48deb243356e622ab589ffc.png[/img]

≪Other Adjustments≫
　・ Changed the order of appearance for materials at the Colosseum

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]6．Adjusted pricing of Nimbus Cotton[/h1]

　The Nimbus Cotton is now cheaper! Yay!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f09f434f0f0d8d2c803bd2f00e97223c2a50542b.png[/img]

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]7．Other Minor Adjustments[/h1]

　[System Related Changes]
　　・ Fixed the clunky cursor movements in the name input section
　[Tutorial Related Changes]
　　・ Added “Tat Wiz” to tutorial
　　・ Fixed some texts in the tutorial
　　・ Changed some of the captures in the tutorial screen
　[Map related changes]
　　・ Moved around some locations of destructible objects 
　　・ Changed the texts on many signs
　　・ Changed the effects when jumping maps at the Phantom Tower
　　・ Added Auto Save points to each floors of the Phantom Tower
　　・ Changed the Map Jump location for the Colosseum floor of the Phantom Tower
　　・Changed how the Map Jump indicator is shown on the Colosseum floor of the Phantom Tower
　[Item Related Changes]
　　・ Added more locations the Nimbus Cotton can access
　　・ Changed the order of locations the Nimbus Cotton can access
　[Monster Related Changes] 
　　・ Changed locations for some monsters
　　・ Added a new type of monster
　　・ Made slight adjustments to some monster attack animations
[Weapon Related Changes]
　　・ Adjusted motion of the third strike for the “Blade”

[b]------------------[/b]

[h1]8．The “other” controller issue[/h1]
　[b]Some Xbox One and Xinput controllers not working properly [/b]
This problem is occurring to a small portion of our users.  We’re still trying to figure out what is causing this issue but players who are using, or have used any third-party “key mappers” in the past seem to be encountering issues with their said controllers.
Steam natively supports both Xbox One and most USB Xinput devices and these third-party apps may be interfering with our input system.
If this case does apply to you, we would like to ask that you turn off (and/or remove) any third-party mappers until we find a workaround for this bug. 
Additionally, please try accessing the controller settings through Steam to see if your controllers are being recognized properly.

[b]------------------[/b]

That’s it for this Hotfix!
Some features we’ve planned on adding have been added but we mostly focused on incorporating what you, the users, asked for us!
In other words, if it weren’t for your voices, none of this could have been put together.
We’re so happy to hear from all of you all the time, and are really grateful for all your support!

We’ll continue to do our best in trying to keep providing the best experience GOKEN can offer to old-school gamers out there!
-Best Regards from the GOKEN Team-

notes.title: Developer's Report
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/E0dppoU.png[/img]
Hello adventurers!
My name is Mihara and I’m the director of GOKEN.

I hope you are enjoying your time with GOKEN.
And if you haven’t been able to play GOKEN yet, we really hope you get the chance to do so soon!

GOKEN was an early access title released back in July 28th of 2017.

During the last two months, we tried working very closely with the community to improve quality and add many features until we finally released GOKEN officially on Sep. 29th, 2017.

I, as well as are entire staff, would like to take this opportunity and thank those who have been by our side since this entire time from the bottom of our hearts. 

[h1]About GOKEN[/h1]
GOKEN is a game developed with a mission to “bring back the old-school gaming.”
Utilizing the old-school quarter view camera, combined with chibi-characters walking around the screen, grinding, leveling, forging gear and fighting big bad bosses…
We really tried hard to bring back the good old style of gaming from “back in the days.”

GOKEN follows on some of the most fundamental features that made RPGs what they are today.
For instance, there is not a single boss you cannot defeat by simply leveling your character.
But at the same time, being an “action” RPG allows users to beat the same opponents at a lower level provided they have the necessary skills, although, that usually doesn’t end too well.
We really hoped that users would share this sense of tension and fun as they play through GOKEN.

On the other hand, if users seek a AAA full-3D map, rich with character voices and explosions and animations everywhere, their expectations may not be met with GOKEN.
However, we can safely say, that our game has an amazing 2D design with beautiful art, detailed animations to support the environment, and while not “epic”, a series of slick effects accompanying each attack move. 

If you like what you’ve been reading so far and have not tried GOKEN yet, I ask that you give it a try to see for yourself!
GOKEN is the perfect example of what happens when new old meets new. 

Since I have already taken up a lot of your time, I’ll go into some “behind the scenes” on a different occasion.

While I still do have your attention, I would also like to express our sincere apologies for some of the complications GOKEN has been causing users since release.
Most bugs reported on the forums have been worked out while others are still being worked on, and we will be releasing patches in the coming weeks in order of the degree of the bugs.
We really appreciate your patience.

We will continue developing GOKEN and future products so you the user, can enjoy more of our titles and help us find what bests fits your interests!

I would like to further extend our gratitude to the great community that’s been with us and all the supporters of our game.

We enjoy many of the contents, video, reviews or even just comments on the forums and try to take in what we can to better improve our game.
Rest assured your voices are being heard by each and every one of us, whatever the language, and is brought up in our meetings so please keep them coming!

And of course, please enjoy GOKEN.

-Director Mihara
(Translated by Kaimer)

------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]<<Update on new version>>[/h1]
[b]-Scheduled Release date-[/b]
(may be delayed depending on test results)

Tokyo Standard Time ： Fri. Oct. 20th, 2017
PST：Thur. Oct. 19th, 2017

[h1]-Scheduled Update Info-[/h1]
The following issues are addressed and improved in this upcoming version.
[list]
    [*]Improved game performance
    [*]Improved dialogue in main story events
    [*]Improved usability of daggers
    [*]Adjusted pricing of items in shops and in the Colosseum
    [*]Many reported bugs
[/list]
 
[h1]Details[/h1]
[b]Problem with Xbox One and Xinput controllers[/b]
The unresponsive “Back” button will be fixed.

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
We’ve optimized player, monster, map and object rendering to improve game performance.
The camerawork is also going to act a little differently in order to improve performance.
Our tests show some pretty good numbers so stay tuned!
　
[b]Loading time[/b]
Loading times have also been greatly reduced. 
Our tests here too have shown pretty impressive results!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7MdH8Y6.png[/img]


[h1]Game Stuck on Signs[/h1]
The following signs where the dialogue repetitively comes back preventing players to progress have been fixed.
(In the meantime, avoid these signs!)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a4G0q9l.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mrmZM4n.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D8hzm7U.png[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
In this next version, we improve various areas of game balance and add additional guidance to help players understand what to do.
Detailed info on this will be revealed upon release of the new version.

notes.title: HOTFIX Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/756b0a99759303680cd41192a366bc0ea36da52d.png[/img]

Thanks for the wait guys!

We just released a new patch for GOKEN!

This hotfix includes the following.

[h1]-New Locations for Nimbus Cotton[/h1]
We added more locations to where players can access with the Nimbus Cotton.  Now players can land right in front of visited dungeons.

[h1]-Improved Balance in Combat[/h1]
Made various adjustments for weapons in combat.  Some weapons should feel a lot stronger than how they previously did. Find out which one in-game! 

[h1]-Improved Game Performance[/h1]
The system has been revamped to greatly improve performance compared to previous versions of GOKEN.  Many of the stuttering issues should be fixed with this update if the previous one hadn't!

[h1]-Renewed Tattoo System[/h1]
The Tattoo system has been renewed both graphically and systematically.  The screen should make more sense now and customizability has been greatly increased.

[b]WARNING
The update to the tattoo system required us to reset all ink points.  All skills unlocked at the parlor have been reset after this update.  (All ink points have been returned to players.)[/b]

[h1]Other Bug Fixes[/h1]
Many small bugs have also been fixed, both that have been reported and not.


Let us know what you think about this update and tell us what you would like more!

GOKEN Update Ver. 1,3,0 has just been released!

https://youtu.be/G5SuHUqh7RY

Here's what's in the update...

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Colosseum Mode[/b]
This feature is specifically for those who have reclaimed all five of their swords and either are struggling to gather materials, or simply hungry for more...!
In the new Colosseum Mode, players will [i]fight to their death[/i] facing endless waves of enemies.
Each wave is recorded and players will earn "Colosseum Points" to trade with materials.
Foes will get stronger as waves progress and there will be no limits to their powers...!

[*][b]Additional Side Quests[/b]
More Side-quests will be added, mostly for new players.
[/list]

[b]**WARNING**
After this update, the blacksmith will be unaccessible until a side-quest at "Goodshores" is complete.[/b]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed some compatibility issues between certain controller models and operating systems. 
-Fixed input methods across various UI screens.
-Stuttering issues caused by certain scripts have been fixed (this fix should greatly improve performance but we are aware of other issues that may be causing the stutter.  It's still a work-in-progress but a fix nonetheless...!)
-Other various bugs to improve performance.

We also posted a new video regarding the update on the store page so make sure to check it out!

Let us know what you think about the update and enjoy GOKEN!

notes.title: Update ver 1.2.0 Details - part 2
notes.content:
GOKEN now supports Steam Cloud!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31d558e31538501420daafabe719bd391fea8e21.jpg[/img]

  With this new additional feature, GOKEN can now be played everywhere right where you left off!  Your data would be synced and stored on Steam Cloud. 

  Here are the instructions to enable Steam Cloud:

1. Right click on "[b]GOKEN[/b]" in your Steam [b]LIBRARY[/b]. Then choose "[b]Properties[/b]"

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/02980a70c32d6b9f66bc29282b2e172c3417c46e.jpg[/img]

2. In the "[b]UPDATES[/b]" Tab, make sure you ticked the checkbox that says "[b]Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for GOKEN[/b]". Then [b]Close[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/9e625f098f8f657e56b3ad352e72d7150d752556.jpg[/img]


Remember, that currently we are experiencing trouble when transferring data via Steam Cloud to and from Steam OS to a different operating system.  We are working on this bug as well as many others but in the meantime, make double sure what OS you are transferring save data to and from.
(Steam OS to Steam OS, and any combination of OS that doesn’t involve Steam OS can transfer saves without any problems)

notes.title: Update ver 1.2.0 Details - Part 1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31d558e31538501420daafabe719bd391fea8e21.jpg[/img]

[b]4 New chapters to the tale added![/b]

[h1][b]1. Frappelands - Ice Cave of Tenacity[/b][/h1]

 After his defeat in the Kinari Caves, [b]Norg[/b] was now wondering the world seeking power lead by “a voice.”  
His journey comes to a halt as he reaches the cold of the Frappelands.  
What could have Norg found there?  
What new powers may he possess?  
Only one way to find out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f600f5479d9c9a492bf408b06651e7ca9374d3ae.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]2. Burning Lands - Fire Pit of Rage[/b][/h1]

  Do you remember the [b]Ruler of the Colosseum[/b]? 
  Do you remember his fall?
  What if he too sought the power of the ancients? 
  Sometimes we only get answers the hard way.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/c6c6986362ee822a322a85f0b565d991aa3e44ed.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]3. Great Desert Byuu - Dune of Maw[/b][/h1]

  Sure you remember fighting one of the [b]Cyclops[/b].  
No one is sure what this secret assembly means.  
They too must be lured in by the ancient powers, to a dune in the middle of the great desert.  
What more can the ancient powers do?  There’s only one way to find out!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/b23f75e6e3e908f30dfc400677bcddb6395defc0.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]4. The Long Path - Temple of Chaos[/b][/h1]

  At world’s end, where the old tree of Garla wither’s, a band of villains gather to defeat their sworn enemy. 
  The ancient powers, channeled through the temple takes an unexpected turn and creates something unimaginable and powerful beyond comprehension. 
  Not even Ozone may be up for this one…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/149d169189425edc706fa76d2f110412fb903868.jpg[/img]


Aside from that, there are now [b]quests[/b] added into GOKEN to keep players busy while they are on their journey.

Hope you guys enjoy [b]GOKEN[b]!!!

notes.title: Large Update Ver. 1.2.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/31d558e31538501420daafabe719bd391fea8e21.jpg[/img]

GOKEN takes another big step towards its full release with our 1.2.0 update released!

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/GracefulAcademicGrasshopper-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Here's what we have to offer...

[h1][b]-Wiz Points[/b][/h1]
A new customization option [i]"Wiz Points"[/i] is added to further enable players to customize their hero to their liking.  
Find the [i]Tat Wiz[/i] somewhere in the world to receive "Wiz Points."  The cooler your tattoo is, the more points you will receive!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/f0c93811ee8bb994fa73c979f62557eca5ecefb2.png[/img]

[h1][b]-Quests[/b][/h1]
Aside from the main story, we have now added "Quests" to be played on the side with an all new interface supporting the system.
Complete these quests to receive items that will aid your journey and looting!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/543e789693223588f90f9c7e5ef5170a32581a91.png[/img]

[h1][b]-Additional Story[/b][/h1]
A few extra episodes have been added to the main story!
These stories contain some new dungeons and very powerful bosses, even for those who have already beaten the game are sure to be challenged... BE AWARE.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/35cf761bfebc9f9bae7eba8e13de246b17cbb0ea.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/88ad2c1510157a0bda8a394189d07200c32131b8.png[/img]

[h1][b]-Cloud Saving[/b][/h1]
Cloud saving is added for those who plan on playing GOKEN cross platforms.
Make sure to "save" in-game prior to using this feature as the save file itself needs to be updated.

We are, unfortunately, experiencing trouble transfering save datas to and from Steam OS.
i.e.
Steam OS to Windows OS 
 (Steam OS to Steam OS works flawlessly.)

We are working on a fix but in the mean time, please do not attempt transfering your save from Steam OS to another operating system.


[h1][b]-Game Balance[/b][/h1]
The enemies have been almost entirely revamped to better fit the new environment.  
Due to the players extreme buff by the new Wiz Point system, the game should feel a lot more challenging.


[b]-Others[/b]
Some minor bugs have been tweaked out.


This update contains many new content and systems, so much and so, that players who have already beat the game are sure in for a surprise! (and a challenge of course!)  

I'd like to use this opportunity to thank everyone again for their continued support and hope you enjoy this new chapter of GOKEN!

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.0 Update is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29636570/9c907e70d08a64c9bde8f4bdf04c19e9a49ff9a6.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Thanks to all your reviews and requests, we're releasing the 1.1.0 update with the following features which should greatly improve the game experience!

Specifically, the following improvements have been made.

[h1]Major Improvements Towards Beginning[/h1]
-Adjusted map for much less confusion
-Changed the texts on signs (and placed more of them)
-Added a camp in the Kinari Caves to restore player health
-Added a boss event before reaching the Kinari Caves
-Added multiple NPCs along the way to Cardina through the Kinari Caves


[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
-By holding the Shift key / Circle button / B button, players can now sprint for long distance traveling
-Improved the recovery rate for stamina
-Adjusted balancing of weapons
-Adjusted damage in combat


[h1]Operating Systems[/h1]
-Added Linux Support (Ubuntu 16.04.2 LTS 64 bit, SteamOS）


[h1]Others[/h1]
-Fixed bugs (and spelling errors)

We here at GIANTY are still making further improvements to GOKEN and many of these are based from your feedback!

So please support us by keeping those feedbacks coming; let us know how we can make GOKEN your favorite ARPG ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 1.1.0 update notice!
notes.content:
Hello ladies and gentlemen!

GOKEN 1.1.0 update will be released [b]today[/b]!

This update includes some bug fixes, improvements in systems and most noticeably, [u]Linux support![/u]

A detailed overview will be released with the update later today so stay tuned!

notes.title: Quick Patch Released!
notes.content:
Hello guys.
It's come to our attention that we had a critical bug that prevented some users with outdated dll files from booting GOKEN.

[b]These users would have experienced a hang just after the GIANTY splash logo upon booting the game. [/b]

Seeing this as a rather critical issue, we decided to release a patch to fix specifically this error.

We apologize for any inconvenience we have caused until now.

Stay tuned for future updates and keep your voices coming!


パッチリリースの報告となります。

先日より、GOKENの起動時、GIANTYのロゴ表示後ゲームがフリーズするバグが発覚しました。
「ゲームが起動できない」という緊急性の高いバグであったため、こちらのみ早急に対処させていただき、このたびパッチとしてリリースさせていただくことになりました。

ご不便をおかけした皆様、大変申し訳ございませんでした。

引き続き皆様のご支援、お声を頂き、GOKEN改善に努めてまいりますので、よろしくお願いいたします。
